藏品名称_EN: Plate with tricolor engraved flowers and peony design
描述_EN: A tri-color dish from southern China, thought to have been fired at a kiln in Fujian Province, China, in the late Ming Dynasty. The lotus petal design on the exterior is molded and is a good example of the characteristics of South China Sancai wares, which make extensive use of the molding technique. There are many known South China Sancai plates, but plates with this lotus petal pattern on the outer surface are extremely rare.
描述_ZN: 一个华南地区的三彩盘，被认为是在中国福建省的一个窑场里烧制的，时间是在明朝末年。 外表的莲花瓣图案是模制的，是华南三彩器物特征的一个很好的例子，它广泛使用了模制技术。 已知的华南三彩盘有很多，但外表面有这种莲瓣图案的盘子极为罕见。
